newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pokfulam hits year high in light volume.
newsitem.headline: Pokfulam hits year high in light volume.

text.p: Shares of Pokfulam Development Co Ltd surged to a year high of HK$6.30 on speculation of stronger earnings from upcoming property development sales and market rumours of a takeover bid, brokers said on Monday.
Shares in the property concern close the session on a gain of HK$0.70, or 14 percent, at HK$5.70.

A company official said Pokfulam Development had no property development sales planned at the current time and declined to give further comment. The company also told the stock exchange they were not aware of any reason behind the rise in the share price and that no price-sensitive negotiations were underway.
